title: The Devil Hates the Virgin Birth
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner exposes the dangers of wrongly dividing the word of truth and how it's leading masses astray, even within major Christian denominations. He tackles the critical issue of the virgin birth, revealing how it's at the very heart of the gospel and a central tenet of the Christian faith. Join Pastor Chris as he boldly proclaims the truth of the virgin birth and its significance in our lives today.
